original_test_intent: Verify the GB-NV-PVP leak-protection input detects loss of its physical sensor connection, surfaces the platform-defined tray and BMC fault, and becomes fully healthy again after an approved reconnect.
original_method: Select the exact GB-NV-PVP tray, board input, harness, and sensor; place the liquid-cooling assembly in the approved electrical/hydraulic state; record baseline; have qualified personnel open the mapped connection once; capture local and BMC diagnosis; then inspect, reseat, and prove fault clearing and protection recovery.
manual_activity: A GB-NV-PVP-qualified operator locates and documents the platform connector, performs the approved disconnect/reconnect, observes local hardware state, and inspects the restored connection.
required_inputs: GB-NV-PVP tray, board, harness, sensor, and connector identifiers
Allowed power, coolant flow/pressure, pump, and valve state
Access, ESD, latch, and cable-handling procedure
Expected local diagnostic, BMC sensor/event IDs, assertion and clear timing
Post-reseat inspection and protection recovery requirements
safety_requirements: Use platform-qualified personnel and owner authorization
Confirm electrical and coolant state before access
Operate the connector latch; do not load the harness or pins
Stop for moisture, heat, arcing, damaged hardware, or unexpected cooling action
One stimulus only and no retry after anomaly
Keep the protection impairment bounded and restore under owner control
agent_execution_scope: Validate that evidence names the GB-NV-PVP asset and connector
Collect read-only BMC/Redfish/SEL baselines if approved
Correlate operator timestamps with fault assertion and clearing
Do not reuse generic HW mappings, handle the connector, simulate coverage, approve recovery, or set the verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the platform connector and safe operating envelope
Specify local and management diagnostic acceptance
Supervise the temporary protection impairment and recovery
Review result and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

review_improvement: Converts an underspecified manual unplug step into a platform-bound diagnostic and restoration test without automating or weakening the required physical coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: For GB-NV-PVP, correct management reporting depends on a specific wiring path from the sensor through its board input to a platform channel. A disconnect at another visually similar connector could still generate an alarm yet test the wrong protection path, so asset and connector proof precedes log interpretation. The recovered state must include both electrical continuity and diagnostic clear; merely reseating the plug does not show that the leak channel is reliable or that the system exited any protective actuator state. This direct physical dependency keeps the case manual even though its BMC evidence can be gathered automatically.
